en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 5. Muḥammad ibn Ja’far Al-Qurashi narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain ibn Abil Khaťťāb, from Ḥasan ibn ‘Ali, from Ibn Abī ‘Umayr, from ‘Ali ibn Mughīrah, from Abī ‘Umārah Al-Munshid, who said:
Whenever Ḥusain ibn ‘Ali (a.s.) was mentioned in front of Abī ‘Abdillāh, Ja’far ibn Muḥammad (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) during the day, he would not be seen smiling on that day until nightfall.
